_doc: Single source of truth for the drift-prone currency literals shared across the relay's fake_catalog() (crates/dpay-relay/src/ledger.rs) and the app's BUNDLED_NETWORKS icp-mainnet rows (app/config/catalog.ts; the flat BUNDLED_CATALOG view is DERIVED via icpCatalogOf since Catalog v2 2026-08-27 — there is exactly one bundled shape, the network-first one). Cross-checked by: (1) a Rust #[cfg(test)] drift-alarm in ledger.rs, (2) a jest drift-alarm in app/__tests__/catalog.test.ts. A drift in either direction goes RED. The relay's live /catalog response remains the RUNTIME source of truth; this file + the two fallbacks are COLD-START FALLBACKS only. Does NOT cover the staging deploy script (scripts/dfx-deploy-ic-staging.sh), whose testnet catalog uses genuinely different principals/contracts (Sepolia). The decimals.eth entry pins the 18-dec precision-extreme ckETH entry (currency id 6 in BUNDLED_CATALOG, id 5 in fake_catalog's test fixture). The cketh_ledger principal (the native-ckETH ICRC ledger) is the SAME principal as cketh_gas_ledger (the ckETH ledger also serves as the gas source for ckERC20 cash-out). The vchf_ledger/icp_ledger entries pin the two complete no-minter direct-ICRC assets (currency ids 7/8 in BOTH fallbacks, added 2026-08-28 — see docs/specs/2026-08-28-vchf-icp-support-spec.md); icp_index is the OFFICIAL ICP index canister pinned by the relay's agent_ledger.rs ICP history adapter (a code pin, deliberately NOT a catalog field — no generic index_canister abstraction until a second ledger needs one). The wire_consts object is the canister half (cross-checked by a Rust #[cfg(test)] drift-alarm in crates/dpay-canister/src/types.rs + a jest drift-alarm added by the app side): RETRIEVE_BTC_MIN_AMOUNT mirrors types.rs and the relay's ckBTC withdraw floor; MINT_ACCOUNT (32 bytes of 0xFF) mirrors types.rs and the relay's MINT sentinel / the app's MINT_HEX.
